note: Officially reported national figures only. The Central Election Committee and KCNA publish no per-province results for these elections, so every province is shown with the national figure. Candidates are nominated on one approved list of the Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea, one per constituency (some local constituencies had two in 2023).

elections.title: 2009 Supreme People's Assembly election
elections.note: Each of the 687 constituencies had a single candidate.

elections.title: 2014 Supreme People's Assembly election
elections.note: Kim Jong Un's own constituency, Mount Paektu, reported 100% turnout and no votes against.

elections.title: 2019 Supreme People's Assembly election
elections.note: KCNA said the 0.01% who did not vote were abroad or working at sea.

elections.title: 2023 local people's assembly elections
elections.body: Provincial, city and county people's assemblies
elections.note: Map figures are for provincial assemblies: 99.91% for and 0.09% against. City and county assemblies: 99.87% for, 0.13% against. These were the first votes against reported in decades.
